body:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 20, 2026

Datadog

Application for FP&A Analyst

Dear Datadog team,

Forecasts only help leaders if they can trust them. At Calder Industrial Components I rebuilt the forecast model for our larger business unit around order backlog, and accuracy rose from 88% to 96%. Your R&D Finance team needs that kind of reliability to guide Engineering and Product investment decisions.

As a Financial Analyst I own monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD, and I know how to turn complex data into a clear message for non-finance leaders. I built Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers and cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA. That is the discipline I'd bring to departmental budgets, the annual budget cycle and consistent templates across the organization. My B.S. in Finance and my progress toward ACCA (9 of 13 papers passed) support the financial modeling and analysis this role calls for, and I'm keen to build proficiency in BI tools like Tableau and Metabase.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your R&D Finance team and its partnership with technical leadership. I'm available to talk at your convenience and can discuss a start date that works for you.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt

job.title: FP&A Analyst
requiredSkills: 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A / Strategic Finance, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, and/or other related field
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or economics
niceToHaveSkills: Experience in or understanding of a consumption-based software business model
Proficiency in use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude)
responsibilities: Partner with senior business leaders to manage their departmental budgets on a regular basis, including the company's co-founder and CTO
Manage financial forecasts and analytics across revenue, customers, product, company expenses, and headcount / workforce
Help manage significant portions of the company's spend, including AI and GPU spend across the company
Work on trend, ROI, and profitability analyses on both product and customer levels to support data-driven decision making
Work with finance management on quarterly Board materials, including coordination and consolidation across stakeholders
Assist in planning and budgeting cycles, ensuring consistency in tools, templates, and processes across the organization
Work on ad hoc projects and strategic initiatives for senior management, which may include assessing potential acquisition opportunities and/or negotiations with strategic partners like cloud vendors
Become proficient with financial planning and business intelligence (BI) tools, including Pigment, Tableau, and Metabase
Help create the annual budget and financial targets and work with operational leaders to support execution against goals
